name: @qu/app-renderer
description: Qu V5 App Renderer: turns a resolved Template + Page + stylesheet (see @qu/app-core's AppRuntime) into DOM. sanitizer.js strips <script>/on*-attributes/javascript: URLs from any HTML sourced from Qu content before it ever reaches the DOM (docs/app-shell-arbeitsauftrag.md §17 - content is never trusted as executable); slots.js resolves <qu-slot name="..."> placeholders; styles.js injects a Style Node's CSS into the document, keyed and idempotent per Node id; render.js wires all three into one renderPage() call. No framework, no build step - same vanilla DOM posture @qu/space-ui already commits to.
